scientific_specification.hypotheses: H0-H7 preserved; narrow pilot does not complete them

tasks.split_rule: fixed before responses, grouped paired roots, domain blocked; no target model fitting

models.admission: exact response model+provider, completed exposed reasoning text, no summary or encryption; operational only, full_visible_trace=False
models.model_family_scope: three candidate families; unadmitted routes are exclusions, not silently replaced
models.provider_drift: record and exclude, new route requires new recorded admission

generation.allocation: admit on separate tasks, then deterministic root-balanced task queue across models; stop before sending if budget or deadline fails; report incomplete blocks
generation.deadline: original eight-hour delivery target is retained across cloud-to-local transfer; dispatch ends one hour before delivery

correctness.independent_reference: exact CNF, independent exhaustive topological search, bounded planning simulation, arithmetic recomputation
correctness.strict_format: last nonempty line ANSWER: value; unparseable is its own outcome; correctness estimand and coverage reported separately
correctness.not_a_label: task solvability is not model correctness

measurement.trace_channel: only returned reasoning channel; never reconstructed from answer
measurement.answer_censor: remove first ANSWER: marker and everything after it from predictor input
measurement.word_unit: Unicode non-whitespace spans, not model-native tokens
measurement.input_binding: exact chunk text, Python character offsets, SHA256, response identity verified
measurement.missing_short_traces: exclude per budget without padding; report attempted, completed, gradeable, prefix and embedding coverage by model/domain/split/outcome
measurement.E0: not_passed; no functional-state interpretation or human validation claimed

analysis.target: independently verified final answer correctness from observed prefix
analysis.outer_holdout: each candidate model held out; source models train roots only fit; source validation roots choose C; heldout model test roots evaluated once
baselines: task domain+difficulty and observed prefix statistics
static TF-IDF text and lexical recurrence
pooled segment embedding when semantic representation used
dynamic_addition: adjacent distance mean, sd and slope
controls: three within-trace chunk permutations preserving content and count, retrain each pipeline
analysis.primary_reporting: all heldout-model static-minus-dynamic logloss contrasts at 256 words with BGE-M3; no selection by favorable result
analysis.uncertainty: paired bootstrap of original heldout task roots; replicate roots use multiplicity, never create fictitious independent roots; intervals descriptive and pointwise
analysis.multiplicity: no confirmatory significance or hypothesis confirmation from the matrix of exploratory intervals
analysis.one_class: report not identifiable or smoothed constant baseline; AUROC null; never fabricate both classes
analysis.missing_models: less than two admitted model families means cross-family transfer not estimable

budget.accounting: restore historical rows, verify current endpoint rates, reserve before dispatch under shared lock, retain max(reservation,reported), retain unknown charges

scope_limits: This is a locally timestamped development analysis plan, not an external preregistration.
No claim of common internal computation or complete faithful traces.
No H1 functional-state inference without E0.
No causal stopping policy, cost saving, or full H7 support without intervention.
No H5 intervention or H6 scaling conclusion from unlike checkpoints.
No independent task-family generalization from named RNG variants.
No journal acceptance, published paper, Residency submission or personal leadership claim.
artifacts_required: analysis inputs, predictions, source-fit diagnostics and controls
English manuscript plus Russian result summary

epistemeos.mechanical_completion: does not imply scientific validity; exploratory/inconclusive with review not requested
